label: assertion
text: Global magnitude pruning executed as a one-shot operation or as global Iterative Magnitude Pruning identifies winning-ticket subnetworks at extreme sparsity levels on the ModelNet40 3D shape classification dataset more reliably than iterative layer-local pruning.
完整表述: Global magnitude pruning executed as a one-shot operation (a single pruning cycle, J=1) or as global Iterative Magnitude Pruning (IMP) identifies winning-ticket subnetworks at extreme sparsity levels on the ModelNet40 3D shape classification dataset more reliably than iterative layer-local pruning.

label: assertion
text: one-shot global pruning at 99% sparsity achieves higher test accuracy than both iterative local pruning and global IMP across the PointNet, DGCNN, and PointCNN network architectures.
完整表述: One-shot global pruning (a single pruning cycle, J=1) at 99% sparsity achieves higher test accuracy than both iterative local (i.e., layer-local) pruning and global Iterative Magnitude Pruning (IMP) across the PointNet, DGCNN, and PointCNN network architectures.
完整表述_不含instance: One-shot global pruning (a single pruning cycle, J=1) at 99% sparsity achieves higher test accuracy than both iterative local (i.e., layer-local) pruning and global Iterative Magnitude Pruning (IMP) across the PointNet, DGCNN, and PointCNN network architectures.
